Quick technical/pricing note — adding here so procurement has context.

Marissa / Rajiv — based on the rough profile you mentioned (300–500 qps ingest during business hours, ~10k embeddings/month), initial sizing looks like:
- Hosted POC for 4–6 weeks: small dedicated cluster not required; we can provision hosted capacity with warm nodes.
- Recommended Dedicated (if steady-state): 2x A10x nodes (or equivalent) with autoscale policy for peak bursts — this keeps median latencies <120ms and reduces unit token cost ~35% vs hosted.

I’ll attach the pricing worksheet (stub) for Emily — it includes list pricing + an example committed discount ladder. If Acme expects higher embeddings or >1k qps sustained, we’ll revise sizing.
